description: Access Roles' dashboard page is in the dashboard's menu and, opened as an admin, shows the status from GET /AccessRoles/Admin/Diagnostics as text: the build (0.9.11; since 0.9.8 the page is the kit's dashboard module, since 0.9.11 with the tabs Overview, Roles, Users, Libraries, Audit, Settings, Data and Diagnostics; it opens on the Overview while the import is offered, and the status tables are the Diagnostics tab's, which this opens), the library sync, the settings locks and the hardening active and no lock left not enforced, the data file Ok at schema 1, the action manifest matching the server's 390 Jellyfin.Api actions, and the server's users; while nobody is managed, Import current setup is shown with Apply disabled until a preview. accessroles-probe.mjs --webcheck runs it.

steps.name: the dashboard's menu lists Access Roles
the menu entry
steps.eval: (() => { const a = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')).find(a => /configurationpage\?name=AccessRoles/.test(a.getAttribute('href'))); return { href: a.getAttribute('href'), text: a.textContent.trim() }; })()

steps.name: the status is filled in, on the Overview tab
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return !!p && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus table').length === 5 && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesTabOverview').getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true' && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesScriptNote').hidden === true; })()

steps.name: the status tables are on the Diagnostics tab
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const panel = p.querySelector('#AccessRolesPanelDiagnostics'); return p.querySelector('#AccessRolesTabDiagnostics').getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true' && !panel.hidden && panel.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus table').length === 5 && panel.querySelector('#AccessRolesStatus').getBoundingClientRect().height > 0; })()

steps.name: what the page shows
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const rows = {}; p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus tr').forEach(tr => { rows[tr.querySelector('th').textContent] = tr.querySelector('td').textContent; }); return { title: p.querySelector('h2').textContent, note: p.querySelector('#AccessRolesBuildNote').textContent, banners: Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesBanners .jfar-page-banner')).map(b => b.textContent), loadingHidden: p.querySelector('#AccessRolesLoading').hidden, rows }; })()

steps.name: what is enforced, said twice
steps.assert: __vars.shown.note === 'Settings locks, the admin surfaces and the server-wide hardening are enforced, and library roles are written to users\' library access.' && __vars.shown.rows['Enforcement'] === __vars.diagnostics.Enforcement.Message

steps.name: the settings locks enforced, with the filter's counts
steps.assert: /^Enforced; since the start \d+ refused, \d+ reverted, \d+ failed closed$/.test(__vars.shown.rows['Settings locks'])

steps.name: no lock left not enforced (AdminSurfaces and UserDirectory are enforced too)
the server-wide rules as they apply
steps.assert: /^configuration reads: encoding; restart administrators only; public user list trimmed; library hardening Standard; since the start \d+ hidden$/.test(__vars.shown.rows['Server-wide rules'])

steps.name: the library sync as Diagnostics has it
the data file as Diagnostics has it
the manifest matches the server
steps.assert: __vars.shown.rows['This server'] === 'All 390 of its Jellyfin.Api actions are in the list, unchanged.' && __vars.shown.rows['Actions'] === '390, 110 with rules' && /^Jellyfin 10\.11\.5 \(jellyfin v10\.11\.5, commit 1e27f460fe741429a1200b3ceb524d34e5d524ce\)$/.test(__vars.shown.rows['Reviewed for'])

steps.name: Import current setup while nobody is managed, Apply disabled before a preview
steps.assert: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return __vars.diagnostics.Records.Assignments === 0 && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesImport').hidden === false && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesImportApply').disabled === true && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesImportPreview').disabled === false; })()

steps.name: every value is text (no element inside a value cell but the lists)
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
